Subject: Post-call recap & next steps (data handling / training opt-out)

Hi Alice / Bob 	6

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and agreed next steps around data handling: 

- AcmeFin confirmed the main product flow will send transactional customer messages (no card data) to Redwood API for personalization and summarization.
- Key controls you asked about: PII handling, token-level logging, retention windows, and ability to opt out of training-on-customer-data.
- Action items for Redwood: provide a signed confirmation that AcmeFin data will not be used to improve model weights (training opt-out), and share the Data Processing Addendum (DPA) with retention/logging controls called out.

I attached the standard Data Processing Addendum and a short "training opt-out" confirmation template we use for customers who opt out of model improvement. Once you sign the opt-out we will mark the account and ensure the model improvement flag is disabled for your requests.

Next steps (agreed):
1) I will send the DPA + opt-out template (attached).
2) AcmeFin to confirm signatory and return signed opt-out + DPA (procurement looped if needed).
3) We will schedule a 30-min security follow-up if you want to review the logging controls and retention TTLs in the console.

Let me know if I missed anything. Rishi / Kimberly 	6 please standby to help on commercial/contract questions once procurement engages.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Hi Alice / procurement team 	6

Thanks for confirming the opt-out. A few quick answers to your questions: 

- Redaction: We recommend redacting PII client-side where feasible. For troubleshooting logs, Redwood supports configurable redaction rules in the Console and we can enable additional automatic redaction on our logging pipeline for fields you specify. We can capture request/response metadata (latency/error codes) while removing redacted fields from stored logs.
- Retention: Hosted default token retention is 30 days. For Dedicated / Private deployments we can set a custom retention TTL; we will note AcmeFin's preferred window in the DPA.

I've attached the Data Processing Addendum (with retention TTL field highlighted) and the training opt-out confirmation template. Please confirm the signer and I'll send a DocuSign envelope.
